purpose: Create an independent, deterministic, lab-generated corpus cohort reserved exclusively for final release confirmation after all remaining development, model-selection, calibration, and policy choices are frozen.

content.source: deterministic SHA-256-derived synthetic strings using a release-holdout-specific seed namespace
content.format: one supported key=value assignment per line
content.safety: The generator does not use or emit live credentials, local collected values, filesystem paths, per-record IDs, or scanner predictions.

ownership.write_scope: Only the contract-owned release-holdout-XX/cohort-01.conf paths below the explicitly selected root.
ownership.idempotence: Existing matching files are retained; mismatched files fail closed and are never overwritten.
ownership.verification: --check verifies every expected release-holdout-001 document and its deterministic content.

evaluation.role: Every release-holdout family is assigned only to release_holdout. It is excluded from training, model selection, calibration, policy selection, and intermediate comparisons.
evaluation.isolation: A duplicate-connected component containing both a release-holdout group and development group fails closed. The release-holdout result may be reported only after the complete release candidate is frozen.
